audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer marks six of seven rows "Skill" while content win[] and packet.levelChart both give Diana all seven, at a 51.44% win rate over 2189 games.
audit.why: Twisted Fate has no shield, no dash and no peel; his only lane CC is the gold card on a flat 6s Pick a Card. Diana's 900 Q into an 825 Lunar Rush beats that from level 3 onward, and Moonfall at 100s badly out-cycles Destiny at 170s.
audit.corrected: Move the six "Skill" rows onto Diana to match the content layer and packet.

audit.why: Level 3 Q-E-Q burst, level 6 Moonfall (100s) against a 170s Destiny, first item, and a late game where his value is global rather than 1v1. The content spikes already carry this and match the kit cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never says Pick a Card is an auto-attack reset, so it tells you to watch for the cast when the real tell is the wind-up. breakdown.cooldowns also has no digit in it, and winCon tells you to "dash the silence" — Twisted Fate has no silence in his kit.
audit.why: enemyKit flags autoReset on W and Riot's text describes it as loading his next attack, which is why the damage arrives on the swing rather than the cast. Nothing in his kit silences.
audit.corrected: Put the auto-reset tell and the flat 6s into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d, and rewrite winCon without the invented silence.

audit.whatIsWrong: content mid says he is deleted "if he's ever caught without Blue Card shield timing right" — Pick a Card's blue card has no shield component. Two ability names are also mistyped: "Pick Card" and "Wild Card".
audit.why: Riot's text gives Pick a Card bonus effects on the next attack and nothing resembling a shield; the correct names are Pick a Card and Wild Cards.
audit.corrected: Rewrite content mid around the gold card being on cooldown, and correct both names.

edits.before: Absorb the burst, dash the silence, and pull the conclusion. Shorthand: Pick a Card (Gold) down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Absorb the gold card, dash the second he locks it in, and pull the conclusion. Shorthand: W spent, wave right, go.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Pale Cascade has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is a flat 6s and it is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. Back off the moment it glows yellow. - Wild Cards is 6s at rank 1. - Pale Cascade is 15s at rank 1. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1 and reveals you.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Pick a Card is a flat 6s — the second the gold card is spent, Q-mark him and Lunar Rush in before he can re-lock it.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Unmarked, Lunar Rush is a 22-second dash with no reset — land the crescent first or you arrive next to him alone.

edits.before: Twisted Fate wins by landing Pick a Card (Gold), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Twisted Fate wins by holding the gold card until you commit, stunning you out of the reset, and cashing Destiny elsewhere.

edits.before: First item onward, chain the phases: mark-dash the contacts, R the river clumps, and reset through whatever groups.
edits.after: Track Destiny's 170s: the moment he Gates to a sidelane, shove and take the objective the map is now short a body for.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Carry by punishing Destiny — 170s at rank 1, so once he Gates away, take the fight he just left behind him.

edits.before: Once you have Q-E-Q burst online you can walk him down through Wild Cards chip damage and win the trade outright before he gets a second Pick Card off.
edits.after: Once you have Q-E-Q burst online you can walk him down through Wild Cards chip damage and win the trade outright before Pick a Card is back off its 6s.

edits.before: Shove waves fast to deny his Pick Card poke angles
edits.after: Shove waves fast to deny his Pick a Card angles

edits.before: Farm safely with Wild Card poke and avoid extended trades
edits.after: Farm safely with Wild Cards poke and avoid extended trades

edits.before: Your level 6 spike hits like a truck: Moonfall plus full combo deletes him if he's ever caught without Blue Card shield timing right. He'll try to use Destiny to roam and set up kills elsewhere on the map, which is his actual win condition in this matchup, so ping his ult and watch for sidelane calls. If he ults for vision instead of a pick, that's your cue to shove and roam yourself.
edits.after: Your level 6 spike hits like a truck: Moonfall plus full combo deletes him any time he is caught with the gold card still on cooldown. He'll try to use Destiny to roam and set up kills elsewhere on the map, which is his actual win condition in this matchup, so ping his ult and watch for sidelane calls. If he ults for vision instead of a pick, that's your cue to shove and roam yourself.

notes: Chart: full layer had six rows on 'Skill'; content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Diana on all seven. I moved the full layer onto the content values, so there is NO paired win[N] edit — win[N] is already Diana on every row and an edit whose before equals its after cannot be written. The existing whys on those rows already described Diana winning, so nothing argues with itself after the move. winCon told the reader to 'dash the silence' — Twisted Fate has no silence anywhere in his kit; removed. 'Blue Card shield timing' in content mid was a fabricated mechanic (blue card restores mana, it does not shield) and is now the gold card's cooldown instead. packet.suspectNames was right on both counts this time: 'Pick Card' and 'Wild Card' are mistypes of Pick a Card and Wild Cards. Left alone and flagged: content spikes[2].text says 'Blue Card poke' — the kit text describes no card colours at all, so I could not ground a correction from it and would rather leave the phrase than invent one; the same applies to 'lucky gold card stun chain' in content late, which the page's own Pick a Card (Gold) convention already supports.
